results.title: Are Temperament and Personality Traits Sibling Constructs or Twins? Toward a Lif
results.reason: This paper focuses on theoretical integration of temperament and personality constructs across lifespan development, without clear clinical application or relevance to practicing therapists, psychologists, or psychiatrists. It examines conceptual overlap between these constructs but does not address therapy, assessment, diagnosis, psychopathology, mental health interventions, or neuropsychology.
